newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EURO COMMISSIONER PRAISES STABILITY, REFORM.
newsitem.headline: EURO COMMISSIONER PRAISES STABILITY, REFORM.

text.p: European Commissioner Hans van den Broek said on Thursday that political stability was an invaluable asset to Lithuania as it prepares itself for eventual membership in the European Union.
"Stability and security in this area is of great importance to the European Union," Van den Broek said at a joint news conference with Lithuanian Foreign Minister Algirdas Saudargas.
"It is a great asset of this country that it has political stability," he added.
Lithuania's governoring coalition, like the previous government, enjoys a solid parliamentary majority which has spared the country from serious political turbulence.
The commissioner also said that he was impressed by "the firm determination of this government to fight crime and corruption."
He added that the government's reform programme was moving in the right direction.
"The government has presented a reform package...that is very crucial in the preparatory process toward (EU) membership," he said.
